speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Subacute Combined Degeneration of the Spinal Cord due to Vitamin B12 Deficiency (likely Pernicious Anemia).

The combination of progressive gait ataxia (right leg weakness/falls) and significant cognitive decline (forgetfulness, paranoia) in a 44-year-old male is highly suggestive of this condition. Can you tell me if you or your father have ever been diagnosed with anemia, or if you notice any difficulty with fine motor tasks like writing or buttoning shirts?
